scenarios.immediate: Running set drops from 3 to 2 units (3.5 MWe); load above it rides on the battery for minutes.
independent_resources: standby unit (warm start hours, cold start a day)
scenarios.time_to_irreversible: none while 2 units carry the mission core (0.68 MW nominal); proactive defense stays only if 2 units cover 3.3 MW
scenarios.recovery: start the standby unit; replace or repair the failed unit by ORU (power conversion) or retire it (reactor)
common_mode: shared coolant header per blade
shared bus if the two units sit on one bus
scenarios.uncertainty: unit failure rate u = 0.02-0.10 per unit-year assumed; real Brayton/reactor reliability unknown
scenarios.ship_and_mission: SAFE with N+1; B (2 x 100 %) loses its redundancy at once

scenarios.immediate: L2 gone. Battery carries the coast load for 0.16 h before touching the black-start reserve.
independent_resources: L1 drive generators only with the drive lit
scenarios.time_to_irreversible: cryo: sealed He-3 hold ~58 h, then ~24 t/day of He-3 boils off; protection at high velocity: lost at once
scenarios.recovery: restart one L2 unit from the battery black-start reserve; if no unit restarts, the mission ends (drive propellant cannot be kept)
common_mode: common fuel/design fault across identical units
shared heat-rejection channels
control software
scenarios.uncertainty: whether identical modules share a design-level failure mode
scenarios.crew_survival: SAFE for 30 d on L3 (crew-only 18 kW nominal)
scenarios.ship_and_mission: LOST after the cryo hold unless one unit restarts: cryo preservation is an L2 job, not an L3 job

scenarios.scenario: Main drive trip during high-power operation
scenarios.immediate: L1 lost with hot blades and drained warm channels: burn heat pumps stop; active defense loses its supply.
independent_resources: WARM section (5 MW) frees up for L2 at reduced power (~1.0-1.3 MWe)
scenarios.time_to_irreversible: decay heat 569 kW at 60 s, 234 kW at 1 h: hot loop must keep circulating; proactive defense (2.5 MW) cannot be held until the channels refill
scenarios.recovery: refill and re-prime warm channels, restart L2 from hot standby, then diagnose the drive
common_mode: drive and L1 share the aft district (DRIVE_AFT)
hot-loop pumps on L1
scenarios.uncertainty: drive standby and restart energy are OPEN (PROP.DRIVE_STANDBY)
scenarios.ship_and_mission: DEGRADED: protection gap during the burn-to-coast transition

scenarios.scenario: Loss of one electrical bus (A or B)
scenarios.immediate: Half the distribution lost; loads dual-fed from A and B transfer.
sheddable: non-dual-fed loads on the lost bus
scenarios.time_to_irreversible: none if essential loads are dual-fed and each bus carries the must-keep set (3.3 MW nominal)
scenarios.recovery: isolate the fault, repair the switchgear ORU
common_mode: bus trunks in the same keel lane (Phase I rule: never)
shared PMAD cold plates on LOW
scenarios.ship_and_mission: SAFE if each bus is rated for the must-keep set

scenarios.immediate: Essential loads lose their independent feed; they still run from A/B.
independent_resources: L3 source can be cross-tied to A
scenarios.time_to_irreversible: none while A/B run; it becomes critical only in a coincident F02
scenarios.recovery: repair E; until then F02 becomes crew-critical
common_mode: E routed with A or B
L3 source location beside the refuge

scenarios.immediate: One blade warm circuit lost: the L2 units on that blade lose their sink; ECLSS loops on that ring go to the other.
independent_resources: other two blades (each carries ~1/3 of the warm area)
sheddable: L2 units on the lost blade
scenarios.time_to_irreversible: ring: hours (cabin heat-up); cryo: depends on the LOW section (1 MW, already above capacity in the active bound)
scenarios.recovery: isolate the leak, refill from coolant spares, restart the units
common_mode: shared header across blades (design must split it)
one LOW section for all cryocoolers
scenarios.uncertainty: coolant inventory and leak rates OPEN
scenarios.ship_and_mission: DEGRADED: one third of L2 capacity

scenarios.immediate: In a burn, warm heat beyond the 5 MW WARM section has no sink.
scenarios.time_to_irreversible: seconds to minutes for active defense heat; the base load fits the WARM section
scenarios.recovery: shed defense to proactive within the buffer, restart pumps
common_mode: pumps on L1 (drive trip takes both)
scenarios.ship_and_mission: DEGRADED: active defense not available in burns

scenarios.immediate: Tanks warm; He-3 at 3 K is the critical stage.
independent_resources: N+1 cryocooler trains on A and B
sheddable: 20 K stage before 3 K (it cannot: 3 K cannot lift the shield load)
scenarios.time_to_irreversible: ~58 h sealed hold; losing only the 3 K stage costs 1.2 t/day He-3
scenarios.recovery: Re-cooling after a hold: a warmed vessel must be brought back below its relief point; with the 20 K shield back, the 3 K stage recovers ~0.1 K a day per 100 W of spare lift (slow): spare lift capacity sets recovery.
common_mode: LOW section 300 K rejection
both trains on one bus
scenarios.uncertainty: tank insulation performance over six years
scenarios.ship_and_mission: MISSION-CRITICAL: He-3 losses end the braking budget

scenarios.immediate: Buffer drawn per engagement; recharge from the L2 margin; heat debt accumulates.
independent_resources: dedicated defense buffer (not the pulse bank)
L2 margin above the proactive load
scenarios.time_to_irreversible: when the recharge time exceeds the interval between engagements the buffer runs down: see the duty sweep (eps_b duty)
scenarios.recovery: reduce engagement duration or accept the continuous-active bound (25.8 MW design, 939 t class)
common_mode: buffer and L2 margin are the same generators
scenarios.uncertainty: engagement frequency is OPEN (dust environment, detection range)
scenarios.ship_and_mission: DEGRADED or LOST protection above the sustainable duty

scenarios.scenario: Loss of a generator during high-velocity coast
scenarios.immediate: As F01 but proactive defense is mandatory at this velocity.
scenarios.time_to_irreversible: protection gap if the remaining units cannot cover 3.3 MW; a dust strike in the gap is the irreversible event
scenarios.recovery: start the standby unit; with B-lean (2 x 3.64) one loss leaves 3.64 MW, at the edge of the must-keep set
common_mode: same as F01
scenarios.uncertainty: dust flux at 0.016 c (lab dust study uses the Vertex profile)

scenarios.immediate: Ride-through spent; the black-start reserve is protected and is not spent on loads.
scenarios.time_to_irreversible: crew-only on the battery ride-through: 30 h; whole battery 4.4 d; L3 adds 30 d
scenarios.recovery: restart L2 from the reserve; if not, L3 for 30 d awaiting repair
common_mode: battery shared by ride-through and reserve (one pack)
scenarios.uncertainty: battery degradation (0.5-2 %/yr) at end of life

scenarios.immediate: All buses dark; L3 keeps crew-only loads; the reserve restarts in steps (pulse bank charged from the main battery).
scenarios.time_to_irreversible: cryo hold ~58 h sets the deadline for an L2 restart
scenarios.recovery: step sequence of power.black_start; the survival reserve never charges the pulse bank or restarts the drive
common_mode: restart depends on one battery pack and one control path
scenarios.uncertainty: restart energy of an L2 unit and its start time
scenarios.ship_and_mission: SAFE if an L2 unit restarts inside the cryo hold

summary.crew: The crew survives every scenario for 30 d on L3 plus the refuge, provided the L3 source is independent of L2 and E.
summary.ship: The ship and mission depend on L2 restarting within the ~58-77 h cryo hold and on the protection gap at high velocity; both need N+1 modular L2 with units on different blades and buses.
summary.not_credited: Redundancy is not credited across identical units for a design-level fault, across units sharing a blade header, or between L1 and the drive.
